newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA POLICE SAY 37 SUSPECTS ESCAPE IN HONEYDEW.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA POLICE SAY 37 SUSPECTS ESCAPE IN HONEYDEW.

text.p: South African police on Tuesday reported that 37 suspects in police custody had escaped from the Honeydew station northwest of Johannesburg after overpowering an officer.

The predawn jailbreak occurred at about 4 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Monday when a policeman unlocked one of the cells to check if everything was in order. He was assaulted and hit over the head before losing consciousness, police said in a statement.
The prisoners took keys to the other cells which they unlocked, and fled with the officer's service pistol.
Of those who escaped, two were wanted for house break-ins and one for theft. The remaining 34 were arrested on suspicion of being illegal immigrants.
